# emit_playground — playground screens → hermetic frozen surfaces

Renders each screen of the app's React+Babel design playground
(`<app>/design/new/index.html`) to a chrome-stripped, self-contained static
HTML file at `design/new/surfaces/<surface>.html`, so the freeze gate
(`tools/freeze_design.sh` check 5) can validate them. Freeze's render check
loads `surfaces/*.html` headlessly and fails on any console/page error, so
emitted files are **hermetic**: no React/Babel/CDN, all CSS inlined, DOM
pre-rendered.

## Usage

```sh
python3 emit_playground.py [--app <app-root>]   # emit (default app: $APPBOX_APP)
python3 emit_playground.py --app <app-root> --check  # pre-gate drift guard
python3 emit_playground.py --self-test          # hermetic calibration
EMIT_RENDER=skip python3 emit_playground.py     # skip the browser pass
```

Exit discipline (`freeze_design.sh` precedent — a gate never auto-installs):

- **0** — every emitted surface rendered error-free (write-on-diff:
  unchanged files report `unchanged`, nothing is rewritten); with `--check`,
  every surface `in-sync`
- **1** — `window.P2.registry` missing/not an array, a render console/page
  error, an extraction failure (bad selector, no `.phone-screen` root), or —
  with `--check` — any surface DRIFT
- **2** — environment: no app root (`--app`/`$APPBOX_APP` both absent), or no
  render backend

## `--check` — the pre-gate drift guard

`--check` renders every registry surface exactly as a normal emit would but
WRITES NOTHING: each rendered result is compared byte-for-byte against the
on-disk `design/new/surfaces/<surface>.html` and reported per-surface as
`in-sync` or `DRIFT` (a missing file is DRIFT). Exit 0 only when all surfaces
are in-sync and every render check passes; any drift or render failure exits
1 naming the files. Run it in CI or by hand before
`pipeline.sh gate prototype` so emitted surfaces can't silently diverge from
the playground. Files under `design/new/surfaces/` whose names match no registry
surface are **orphans**: reported as informational `note:` lines, never
failures (legacy frozen surfaces legitimately exist).

## How it works

1. Serves `<app>/design/` on an ephemeral port (in-process `http.server` via
   `socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer`), loads `new/index.html` in headless
   Chromium (viewport 390×844) and evaluates `window.P2.registry` — an array
   of `{id, shell, roles, surface, ...}` where `surface` is a canonical ID or
   `null`. Entries with `surface: null` are playground-only, never emitted.
2. Per emitted entry, picks an allowed role — `entry.roles[0]`, else the
   role whose shells contain `entry.shell` (from `window.P2.roles`, shape-liberal)
   — and loads `new/index.html?role=<role>&screen=<id>`. After a ~1500ms
   settle, any console `error` or `pageerror` fails the run.
3. Extracts the SCREEN CONTENT only: the `.phone-screen` subtree (the
   playground's iPhone-frame screen area — stage, toolbar, and frame hardware
   are outside it by construction), with every subtree matching a
   `design/exclusions.json` `selectors` entry stripped. Exclusions are
   destructive: keep them scoped to chrome nodes (the `.t-hud` dual-use
   gotcha — see `skills/kit-designer/references/design-system-binding.md`).
4. Composes a standalone doc: full text of `new/tokens.css` + `new/app.css`
   inlined as `<style>` blocks (`/* */` comments stripped first — they carry
   no styling, and dropping them keeps freeze check-3 chrome signatures like
   `tweak` out of the emitted surfaces), the stripped content as `<body>`, asset URLs
   rewritten `assets/...` → `../new/assets/...` so they resolve from
   `surfaces/`, and a timestamp-free banner
   (`<!-- GENERATED by stacked_kit/tools/emit_playground — do not hand-edit.
   Source: ... screen '<id>' (role '<role>'). -->`). Written on diff only.

## Environment (backend cascade)

Mirrors `freeze_design.sh`'s render check exactly:

1. `uv run --with playwright python emit_playground.py --worker ...` (uv present)
2. system `python3` with `playwright` importable (in-process)
3. neither → **exit 2** with install instructions

Chromium binaries already cached at `~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright` are
reused. `EMIT_RENDER=skip` mirrors `FREEZE_RENDER=skip`: the browser pass is
skipped entirely, a skip note is printed, nothing is written — hermetic/CI
runs only.

## Self-test

`--self-test` is hermetic: it copies the jsx-less fixture playground under
`fixtures/app/design/` (own `index.html` + `tokens.css`/`app.css` +
`exclusions.json` + one asset, 3 registry entries: one surface, one
registry-null, one roles-less for the shell-fallback role pick) to a temp app
and asserts: the emitted file lands at the expected `design/new/surfaces/` path;
chrome matching the fixture selector is stripped; no `<script>` tags or
remote URLs survive; CSS comments (a planted `tweak` signature) are stripped
before inlining; asset URLs are rewritten; the registry-null screen is
not emitted; a re-run reports `unchanged`; `--check` is `in-sync` after a
fresh emit, reports an orphan surface as informational only, and reports
DRIFT + exit 1 after a hand edit; planted drift (broken exclusion
selector) leaves chrome in the output — i.e. the strip is selector-driven
and detectable downstream; a missing `window.P2.registry` exits 1 with a
clear message; and the `EMIT_RENDER=skip` path exits 0 writing nothing.
Prints `ALL GREEN` on success. Wired into `tools/test_gates.sh` as the
`emit` group.
